nominee.longerDescription: Getting featured later than probably expected, she very much deserves to be here, cause I think her body is a solid 10/10! The boobs should get a sculpture to use as a reminder as to how that part of the female body peaked. I also love her smarts, but how Kanye portrayed her as a trophy is beyond me. I would also get a bit of enjoyment out of my girlfriend wearing revealing clothes sometimes, to show others what they cannot have, but carrying her around like a stuffed animal is baffling. Unsurprisingly, that didn't help their relationship, although I'm confused about their status at the moment.
